      background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(10,15,30,0.78) 0%, rgba(10,15,30,0.10) 55%, transparent 100%);
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .imagery-item-overlay {
      background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(10,15,30,0.65) 0%, rgba(10,15,30,0.05) 55%, transparent 100%);
    }
    .imagery-item-label {
      position: absolute; bottom: 0.55rem; left: 0; right: 0;
      text-align: center;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    }
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .imagery-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }

    /* Topic tags */
    .tags-block h4 {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.78rem;
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
    }
    .topic-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.65rem; }
    .tag {
      padding: 0.5rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 500;
      background: rgba(41,121,255,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(41,121,255,0.2);
      color: var(--text); cursor: default; transition: all 0.3s;
    }
    .tag:hover {
      background: rgba(0,229,255,0.1); border-color: rgba(0,229,255,0.4);
      color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0,229,255,0.18);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       SPEAKERS
    ============================================================ */
    #speakers { background: var(--bg-alt); }

    .speakers-tba {
      max-width: 680px; margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center; padding: 2.25rem 2rem;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background-image:
        repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 39px, rgba(41,121,255,0.05) 39px, rgba(41,121,255,0.05) 40px),
        repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, transparent 39px, rgba(41,121,255,0.05) 39px, rgba(41,121,255,0.05) 40px);
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .speakers-tba {
      background-image:
        repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 39px, rgba(21,101,192,0.06) 39px, rgba(21,101,192,0.06) 40px),
        repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, transparent 39px, rgba(21,101,192,0.06) 39px, rgba(21,101,192,0.06) 40px);
    }
    .speakers-tba-icon {
      width: 80px; height: 80px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(41,121,255,0.1); border: 2px solid rgba(41,121,255,0.25);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 1.25rem; font-size: 2rem; color: var(--blue);
    }
    .speakers-tba h3 { font-size: 1.55rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .speakers-tba p { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 1.08rem; line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
    .speakers-tba .badges { display: flex; gap: 0.65rem; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 1.5rem; }

    /* Speaker card (keynote) */
    .speaker-card {
      max-width: 820px; margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2rem;
      padding: 2.25rem 2rem; border-radius: 20px;
    }
    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .speaker-card { flex-direction: row; align-items: flex-start; }
    }
    .speaker-photo-wrap { position: relative; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .speaker-photo {
      width: 150px; height: 150px; border-radius: 50%;
      object-fit: cover; object-position: top center;
      border: 3px solid var(--border);
      transition: border-color 0.3s;
    }
    .speaker-card:hover .speaker-photo { border-color: var(--cyan); }
    .speaker-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.6rem; }
    .speaker-badges { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
    .speaker-talk-title {
      font-style: italic; color: var(--cyan); font-size: 1rem;
      line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
    }

    /* Modal */
    .modal-overlay {
      display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 2000;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.65); backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 1.5rem;
    }
    .modal-overlay.open { display: flex; }
    .modal-box {
      position: relative; max-width: 680px; width: 100%;
      max-height: 85vh; overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 2.25rem 2rem; border-radius: 18px;
    }
    .modal-close {
      position: absolute; top: 1rem; right: 1.25rem;
      background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 1.6rem; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .modal-close:hover { color: var(--text); }
    .modal-title {
      font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text);
      margin: 0.5rem 0 0.75rem; line-height: 1.45;
    }
    .modal-divider {
      border: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      margin: 1.25rem 0;
    }
    .modal-section-head {
      font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--cyan);
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      margin: 1.25rem 0 0.5rem;
    }
    .modal-box p {
      font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.75; margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       SCHEDULE
    ============================================================ */
    #schedule { background: var(--bg); }

    .schedule-note {
      text-align: center; margin-bottom: 2rem;
      color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .timeline { position: relative; max-width: 820px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .timeline::before {
      content: ''; position: absolute; left: 1.5rem; top: 0; bottom: 0;
      width: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--blue), var(--cyan), var(--teal));
      border-radius: 2px;
    }
    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .timeline::before { left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    .tl-item { position: relative; padding-left: 4rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .tl-item {
        padding-left: 0; display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 2.5rem 1fr; gap: 0 1.1rem; align-items: start;
      }
      .tl-item:nth-child(odd)  .tl-body { grid-column: 1; }
      .tl-item:nth-child(odd)  .tl-dot  { grid-column: 2; }
      .tl-item:nth-child(odd)  .tl-time { grid-column: 3; }
      .tl-item:nth-child(even) .tl-body { grid-column: 3; }
      .tl-item:nth-child(even) .tl-dot  { grid-column: 2; }
      .tl-item:nth-child(even) .tl-time { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; text-align: right; }
    }
    .tl-dot {
      position: absolute; left: 0.55rem; top: 0.3rem;
      width: 1rem; height: 1rem; border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid var(--bg); flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .tl-dot { position: static; justify-self: center; margin-top: 0.3rem; }
    }
    .tl-dot-keynote { background: var(--blue);       box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--blue); }
    .tl-dot-oral    { background: var(--cyan);        box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--cyan); }
    .tl-dot-poster  { background: var(--teal);        box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--teal); }
    .tl-dot-break   { background: var(--text-muted); }
    .tl-dot-award   { background: var(--gold);        box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--gold); }

    .tl-body { padding: 1.1rem 1.35rem; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .tl-type {
      font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
    }
    .tl-type-keynote { color: var(--blue);      }
    .tl-type-oral    { color: var(--cyan);      }
    .tl-type-poster  { color: var(--teal);      }
    .tl-type-break   { color: var(--text-muted);}
    .tl-type-award   { color: var(--gold);      }

    .tl-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; margin-bottom: 0.3rem; }
    .tl-desc  { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.65; }
    .tl-time  {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.82rem;
      color: var(--text-muted); padding-top: 1.3rem;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       CALL FOR PAPERS
    ============================================================ */
    #cfp { background: var(--bg-alt); }

    .cfp-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2.5rem; }
    @media (min-width: 1024px) { .cfp-grid { grid-template-columns: 1.25fr 1fr; } }

    .cfp-topics h3 { font-size: 1.2rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; color: var(--cyan); }

    .topic-group { margin-bottom: 1.35rem; }
    .topic-group h4 {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.78rem;
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      color: var(--blue); margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
    }
    .topic-list { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.6rem; }
    .topic-list li {
      display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.7rem;
      font-size: 0.98rem; color: var(--text-muted);
    }
    .topic-list li i { color: var(--cyan); font-size: 0.72rem; margin-top: 0.38rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

    /* Submission card */
    .sub-card { padding: 2.1rem; border-radius: 16px; }
    .sub-card h3 {
      font-size: 1.25rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem;
    }
    .sub-card h3 i { color: var(--blue); }

    .sub-row {
      display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.9rem;
      padding: 0.95rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .sub-row { border-bottom-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.06); }
    .sub-row:last-of-type { border-bottom: none; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }

    .sub-icon {
      width: 2.1rem; height: 2.1rem; border-radius: 8px;
      background: rgba(41,121,255,0.1); display: flex;
      align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0;
      color: var(--blue); font-size: 0.88rem;
    }
    .sub-text { font-size: 0.95rem; }
    .sub-text strong { color: var(--text); display: block; margin-bottom: 0.18rem; font-size: 0.98rem; }
    .sub-text span { color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.6; }

    /* ============================================================
       DATES
    ============================================================ */
    #dates { background: var(--bg); }

    .dates-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px,1fr)); gap: 1.5rem; }

    .date-card {
      padding: 1.85rem; border-radius: 16px; position: relative;
      overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
    }
    .date-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
    .date-card::before {
      content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
      height: 3px; border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0;
    }
    .date-card.blue::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--blue), var(--cyan)); }
    .date-card.cyan::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--cyan), var(--teal)); }
    .date-card.teal::before { background: var(--teal); }
    .date-card.gold::before { background: var(--gold); }

    .dc-icon {
      width: 2.6rem; height: 2.6rem; border-radius: 10px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 1.2rem; font-size: 1.15rem;
    }
    .date-card.blue .dc-icon { background: rgba(41,121,255,0.12); color: var(--blue); }
    .date-card.cyan .dc-icon { background: rgba(0,229,255,0.10); color: var(--cyan); }
    .date-card.teal .dc-icon { background: rgba(0,191,165,0.10); color: var(--teal); }
    .date-card.gold .dc-icon { background: rgba(255,214,0,0.10);  color: var(--gold); }

    .dc-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.73rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
    .dc-title { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.65rem; }
    .dc-date  { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 0.8rem; }
    .date-card.blue .dc-date { color: var(--blue); }
    .date-card.cyan .dc-date { color: var(--cyan); }
    .date-card.teal .dc-date { color: var(--teal); }
    .date-card.gold .dc-date { color: var(--gold); }

    .mini-cd { display: flex; gap: 0.55rem; margin-top: 0.8rem; align-items: flex-end; }
    .mcd-unit { text-align: center; }
    .mcd-val { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--blue); display: block; line-height: 1; }
    .mcd-lbl { font-size: 0.62rem; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
    .mcd-sep { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--border); align-self: flex-start; margin-top: 0.05rem; }

    /* ============================================================
       ORGANIZERS
    ============================================================ */
    #organizers { background: var(--bg-alt); }

    .org-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
      gap: 1.75rem;
    }

    /* Top row: 3 senior organizers */
    .org-grid-senior {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
      gap: 1.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    /* Bottom row: 2 early-career organizers */
    .org-grid-jr {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
      gap: 1.75rem;
      max-width: 750px;
    }

    .org-card {
      padding: 1.85rem 1.75rem; border-radius: 18px;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center;
      transition: transform 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .org-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }

    .org-photo-wrap {
      position: relative; margin-bottom: 1.4rem;
    }
    .org-photo {
      width: 110px; height: 110px; border-radius: 50%;
      object-fit: cover; object-position: top center;
      border: 3px solid var(--border);
      transition: border-color 0.3s;
    }
    .org-card:hover .org-photo { border-color: var(--cyan); }

    .org-flag {
      position: absolute; bottom: 4px; right: 4px;
      font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1;
    }

    .org-role {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--cyan); margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
    }
    .org-name { font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
    .org-affil {
      font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 1rem; line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .org-bio {
      font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.7; flex: 1;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       SPONSORS
    ============================================================ */
    #sponsors { background: var(--bg); padding: 3rem 0; }

    .sponsors-inner { text-align: center; }
    .sponsors-inner h2 { font-size: 1.6rem; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
    .sponsors-inner > p { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 1.05rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; }

    .sponsor-strip {
      display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 2.5rem; align-items: center;
    }

    .sponsor-item {
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.85rem;
      padding: 1.75rem 2.25rem; border-radius: 16px;
      background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: border-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
      min-width: 200px;
    }
    .sponsor-item:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-hov);
      box-shadow: 0 0 28px rgba(0,229,255,0.12);
    }
    .sponsor-logo {
      height: 60px; max-width: 200px;
      object-fit: contain;
      /* Ensure logos look OK in both themes */
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .sponsor-logo-invert { filter: none; }

    .sponsor-name { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 500; }

    /* ============================================================
       FOOTER
    ============================================================ */
    footer {
      background: var(--bg-alt); border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 2.5rem 0 1.5rem;
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2rem; margin-bottom: 2rem;
    }
    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1.6fr 1fr 1fr; }
    }

    .footer-brand .nav-logo { font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.85rem; display: inline-block; }
    .footer-brand p { font-size: 0.92rem; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.75; max-width: 290px; }

    .footer-social { display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; margin-top: 1.35rem; }
    .footer-social a {
      width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 9px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.95rem; transition: all 0.3s;
    }
    .footer-social a:hover { background: rgba(41,121,255,0.1); border-color: rgba(41,121,255,0.4); color: var(--blue); }

    .footer-col h4 {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.78rem;
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 1.1rem;
    }
    .footer-col ul { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.65rem; }
    .footer-col ul a { font-size: 0.94rem; color: var(--text-muted); transition: color 0.25s; }
    .footer-col ul a:hover { color: var(--cyan); }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      padding-top: 1.75rem;
      display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1rem;
      justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .footer-bottom { border-top-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.07); }
    .footer-bottom p { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); }
    .footer-bottom a { color: var(--blue); transition: color 0.25s; }
    .footer-bottom a:hover { color: var(--cyan); }
  </style>
</head>

        <span class="cd-sep">:</span>

        <p>

          <p class="speaker-talk-title">"From Fields to Fires to Fens: Integrating Deep Learning and Multi-Sensor Earth Observation for Global Environmental Resilience"</p>
          <p class="org-bio">Remote sensing scientist with 30 years of experience and 112 peer-reviewed publications spanning agriculture, wildfire, and peatland Earth Observation. Editor-in-Chief of the <em>International Journal of Remote Sensing</em> and former WMO and CEOS panel member.</p>
          <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="openSpeakerModal('tansey')" style="margin-top:0.5rem;align-self:flex-start;">

    <!-- Keynote detail modal -->
    <div id="modal-tansey" class="modal-overlay" onclick="closeSpeakerModal(event,'tansey')">
      <div class="modal-box glass-card">
        <button class="modal-close" onclick="closeSpeakerModal(null,'tansey')">×</button>
        <p class="section-label"><i class="fa-solid fa-microphone-lines"></i>  Keynote Address</p>
        <h3 class="modal-title">"From Fields to Fires to Fens: Integrating Deep Learning and Multi-Sensor Earth Observation for Global Environmental Resilience"</h3>
        <p class="org-role" style="margin-bottom:0;">Prof. Kevin Tansey · University of Leicester, UK</p>
        <hr class="modal-divider" />
        <h4 class="modal-section-head">Abstract</h4>
        <p>The convergence of climate change and population growth necessitates advanced Earth Observation (EO) frameworks to monitor terrestrial ecosystems and ensure food security. This talk explores the evolution of remote sensing methodologies — transitioning from traditional statistical models to sophisticated deep learning architectures — to address three critical environmental pillars: agricultural productivity, wildfire dynamics, and peatland preservation.</p>
        <p>In the agricultural domain, the research takes two pathways. The first is a multi-scale deep learning framework integrating time-series satellite data, meteorological variables, and soil characteristics. Using models such as LSTM and neural networks, high-precision county-level yield estimates of crops such as winter wheat are achieved. The second pathway, developed with industry partners in the UK and Nigeria, predicts crop status, harvest windows, and crop type for the determination of crop waste availability for biofuel through a pyrolysis process.</p>
        <p>The increasing frequency of extreme weather events has triggered an increase in wildfire activity outside of normal fire seasons. Work on automated processing pipelines using high-resolution PlanetScope and Sentinel imagery to characterise burned area will be discussed. Using adaptive machine learning classifications, 3-metre resolution burned-area maps are generated, enabling rapid response and long-term ecological impact assessment.</p>
        <p>An overview of findings from the ESA WorldPeatland project — an international initiative dedicated to EO-based mapping and monitoring of peatland hydrology — will be presented. Peatlands are vital carbon sinks, yet highly vulnerable to drainage and fire. The catalogue of products created by the project team and insights into peatland extent, hydrology, and surface motion will be discussed.</p>
        <p>Finally, Prof. Tansey will outline the changing direction of remote sensing and Earth observation research as seen through his role as Editor-in-Chief of the <em>International Journal of Remote Sensing</em>, and the challenges faced by the community regarding the use and misuse of AI in scientific publishing.</p>
        <h4 class="modal-section-head">About the Speaker</h4>
        <p>Kevin Tansey is a Geographer who has worked as a remote sensing scientist since 1995. He has published 112 papers in international peer-reviewed journals across application fields including agriculture, wildfire and hazards assessment, forestry, and renewable energies. He works with all forms of EO data — optical, thermal, radar, and LiDAR — from the ground to space.</p>
        <p>He is Editor-in-Chief of the <em>International Journal of Remote Sensing</em>. He has previously held positions on the United Nations World Meteorological Organization (WMO) Terrestrial Observations Panel for Climate (TOPC) and has been co-chair of the Committee of Earth Observing Satellites (CEOS) Land Product Validation sub-group on fire disturbance. He has supervised more than 25 PhD students and has over 20 years of teaching experience in remote sensing, GIS, and statistics for data science.</p>

<script>
  // ============================================================
  // 1. THEME TOGGLE
  // ============================================================
  function initTheme() {
    const btn  = document.getElementById('themeBtn');
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('hydroimaging-theme') || 'dark';
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', saved);
    updateIcon(saved);

    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const cur  = root.getAttribute('data-theme');
      const next = cur === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
      root.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
      localStorage.setItem('hydroimaging-theme', next);
      updateIcon(next);
    });

    function updateIcon(theme) {
      btn.innerHTML = theme === 'dark'
        ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-sun"></i>'
        : '<i class="fa-solid fa-moon"></i>';
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // 2. CANVAS PARTICLES
  // ============================================================
  function initParticles() {
    const canvas = document.getElementById('hero-canvas');
    const ctx    = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const NUM    = 80;
    const DIST   = 150;
    let W, H, particles = [];

    function isDark() {
      return document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') !== 'light';
    }

    function resize() {
      W = canvas.width  = window.innerWidth;
      H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    }

    class Particle {
      constructor() { this.reset(); }
      reset() {
        this.x  = Math.random() * W;
        this.y  = Math.random() * H;
        this.vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4;
        this.vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4;
        this.r  = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
        this.a  = Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2;
      }
      update() {
        this.x += this.vx;
        this.y += this.vy;
        if (this.x < 0 || this.x > W) this.vx *= -1;
        if (this.y < 0 || this.y > H) this.vy *= -1;
      }
      draw() {
        const dark = isDark();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = dark
          ? `rgba(41,121,255,${this.a})`
          : `rgba(21,101,192,${this.a * 0.7})`;
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }

    function init() {
      resize();
      particles = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < NUM; i++) particles.push(new Particle());
    }

    function animate() {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
      const dark = isDark();

      for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
        for (let j = i + 1; j < particles.length; j++) {
          const dx   = particles[i].x - particles[j].x;
          const dy   = particles[i].y - particles[j].y;
          const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
          if (dist < DIST) {
            const op = (1 - dist / DIST) * (dark ? 0.22 : 0.15);
            const g  = ctx.createLinearGradient(particles[i].x, particles[i].y, particles[j].x, particles[j].y);
            if (dark) {
              g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(41,121,255,${op})`);
              g.addColorStop(1, `rgba(0,229,255,${op})`);
            } else {
              g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(21,101,192,${op})`);
              g.addColorStop(1, `rgba(0,119,182,${op})`);
            }
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(particles[i].x, particles[i].y);
            ctx.lineTo(particles[j].x, particles[j].y);
            ctx.strokeStyle = g;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        }
      }
      particles.forEach(p => { p.update(); p.draw(); });
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    window.addEventListener('resize', init, { passive: true });
    init();
    animate();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // 3. SCROLL ANIMATIONS
  // ============================================================
  function initScrollAnim() {
    const obs = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      entries.forEach(e => {
        if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('visible'); obs.unobserve(e.target); }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.1 });
    document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in').forEach(el => obs.observe(el));
  }

  // ============================================================
  // 4. NAVBAR
  // ============================================================
  function initNavbar() {
    const nav = document.getElementById('navbar');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 60);
    }, { passive: true });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // 5. COUNTDOWN
  // ============================================================
  function initCountdown(target) {
    function pad(n) { return String(n).padStart(2, '0'); }
    function tick() {
      const diff = target - Date.now();
      if (diff <= 0) {
        ['cd-days','cd-hours','cd-mins','cd-secs','mcd-d','mcd-h','mcd-m'].forEach(id => {
          const el = document.getElementById(id);
          if (el) el.textContent = '00';
        });
        return;
      }
      const d = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);
      const h = Math.floor((diff % 86400000) / 3600000);
      const m = Math.floor((diff % 3600000) / 60000);
      const s = Math.floor((diff % 60000) / 1000);
      [['cd-days',d],['cd-hours',h],['cd-mins',m],['cd-secs',s],
       ['mcd-d',d],['mcd-h',h],['mcd-m',m]].forEach(([id,v]) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.textContent = pad(v);
      });
    }
    tick();
    setInterval(tick, 1000);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // 6. MOBILE MENU
  // ============================================================
  function initMobileMenu() {
    const btn  = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    const menu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      btn.classList.toggle('open');
      menu.classList.toggle('open');
    });
    menu.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => a.addEventListener('click', () => {
      btn.classList.remove('open');
      menu.classList.remove('open');
    }));
  }

  // ============================================================
  // BOOT
  // ============================================================
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    initTheme();
    initParticles();
    initScrollAnim();
    initNavbar();
    // May 13, 2026 23:59 AoE = May 14, 2026 11:59 UTC
    initCountdown(new Date('2026-05-14T11:59:00Z').getTime());
    initMobileMenu();
    initSlideshow();
  });

  // ============================================================
  // 7. SPEAKER MODALS
  // ============================================================
  function openSpeakerModal(id) {
    const modal = document.getElementById('modal-' + id);
    if (modal) { modal.classList.add('open'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; }
  }
  function closeSpeakerModal(e, id) {
    if (e && e.target && e.target.id !== 'modal-' + id) return;
    const modal = document.getElementById('modal-' + id);
    if (modal) { modal.classList.remove('open'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; }
  }
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      document.querySelectorAll('.modal-overlay.open').forEach(m => {
        m.classList.remove('open');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      });
    }
  });

  function initSlideshow() {
    const imgs = [
      't1.jpg','t2.jpg','t3.jpg','t4.jpg','t5.jpg','t6.jpg','t7.jpg',
      't8.jpg','t10.jpg','t11.jpg','t12.jpg','t13.jpg','t14.jpg','t15.jpg'
    ];
    const wrap = document.getElementById('heroSlideshow');
    imgs.forEach((name, i) => {
      const el = document.createElement('div');
      el.className = 'hero-slide' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
      el.style.backgroundImage = "url('assets/tampere/" + name + "')";
      wrap.appendChild(el);
    });
    let cur = 0;
    setInterval(() => {
      const slides = wrap.children;
      slides[cur].classList.remove('active');
      cur = (cur + 1) % slides.length;
      slides[cur].classList.add('active');
    }, 4000);
  }
</script>
</body>
</html>

    .fade-in.d4 { transition-delay: 0.4s; }

    /* ===== WAVES ===== */
    .wave-wrap { display: block; line-height: 0; overflow: hidden; }
    .wave-wrap svg { display: block; }

    /* ============================================================
       NAVBAR
    ============================================================ */
    #navbar {
      position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 1000;
      padding: 1.2rem 0;
      transition: background 0.4s, padding 0.4s, backdrop-filter 0.4s, border-color 0.4s;
      border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
    }
    #navbar.scrolled {
      background: var(--bg-nav);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
      border-bottom-color: var(--border);
      padding: 0.7rem 0;
    }
    .nav-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; }

    .nav-logo {
      font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.45rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      color: var(--cyan); text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,229,255,0.4);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .nav-logo span { color: var(--text); }

    .nav-links {
      display: none; align-items: center; gap: 0.15rem; list-style: none;
    }
    .nav-links a {
      padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted);
      transition: color 0.25s, background 0.25s;
    }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--text); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); }

    .nav-right { display: none; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; }

    /* Theme toggle */
    .theme-btn {
      width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 10px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 1rem;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s;
    }
    .theme-btn:hover { color: var(--cyan); border-color: var(--border-hov); }

    /* Hamburger */
    .hamburger {
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px;
      cursor: pointer; background: none; border: none; padding: 4px;
    }
    .hamburger span {
      display: block; width: 24px; height: 2px;
      background: var(--text); border-radius: 2px; transition: all 0.3s;
    }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg); }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }

    /* Mobile menu */
    .mobile-menu {
      display: none; flex-direction: column;
      background: var(--bg-nav); backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 1rem 1.75rem 1.75rem;
    }
    .mobile-menu.open { display: flex; }
    .mobile-menu a {
      padding: 0.8rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
      font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted);
      transition: color 0.25s;
    }
    .mobile-menu a:hover { color: var(--cyan); }
    .mobile-menu .btn { margin-top: 1.1rem; align-self: flex-start; }

    .nav-conf-chip {
      font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      color: var(--cyan); opacity: 0.85;
      display: none;
    }
    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .nav-links  { display: flex; }
      .nav-right  { display: flex; }
      .hamburger  { display: none; }
      .nav-conf-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; }
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .nav-conf-chip { color: var(--blue); }

    /* ============================================================
       HERO
    ============================================================ */
    #hero {
      position: relative; min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--bg) url('assets/hero-bg.jpg') center/cover no-repeat;
    }
    .hero-video-wrap {
      position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero-slide {
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background-size: cover; background-position: center;
      opacity: 0; transition: opacity 1.2s ease-in-out;
    }
    .hero-slide.active { opacity: 1; }
    .hero-bg-overlay {
      position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(10,15,30,0.55) 0%, rgba(10,15,30,0.30) 50%, rgba(10,15,30,0.70) 100%);
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .hero-bg-overlay {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg,
        rgba(240,245,255,0.72) 0%, rgba(240,245,255,0.50) 50%, rgba(240,245,255,0.78) 100%);
    }
    #hero-canvas { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 2; }
    .hero-overlay {
      position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 3;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 40%, rgba(41,121,255,0.09) 0%, transparent 68%);
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .hero-overlay {
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 40%, rgba(21,101,192,0.06) 0%, transparent 68%);
    }

    .hero-content {
      position: relative; z-index: 4;
      text-align: center; max-width: 940px;
      padding: 0 1.75rem; padding-top: 5rem;
    }

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem;
      padding: 0.6rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(41,121,255,0.18); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      color: #fff; margin-bottom: 1.1rem;
      text-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    }
    .hero-badge i { color: #7FE9FF; }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 6.5vw, 5.5rem);
      font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.1; margin-bottom: 0.9rem;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 0%, #00E5FF 40%, #82B1FF 70%, #ffffff 100%);
      background-size: 300% 300%;
      -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
      animation: gradShift 7s ease infinite;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.65));
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .hero-title {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 0%, #64DFFF 40%, #90CAF9 70%, #ffffff 100%);
      background-size: 300% 300%;
      -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }
    @keyframes gradShift {
      0%   { background-position: 0% 50%; }
      50%  { background-position: 100% 50%; }
      100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
    }

    .hero-tagline {
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.25rem);
      color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 1.75rem; font-weight: 400;
    }
    .hero-tagline strong { color: var(--cyan); font-weight: 600; }

    .hero-actions {
      display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1rem;
      justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 2rem;
    }

    /* Countdown */
    .countdown-wrapper { margin-top: 0.25rem; }
    .countdown-label {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: var(--text-muted);
      text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
    }
    .countdown {
      display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 1.1rem; flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .cd-unit { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.3rem; }
    .cd-val {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 2.8rem); font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--cyan); text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,229,255,0.45);
      min-width: 3ch; text-align: center; line-height: 1;
    }
    .cd-lbl { font-size: 0.68rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--text-muted); }
    .cd-sep {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 2.2rem;
      color: var(--border); align-self: center; padding-bottom: 1.1rem;
    }

    .hero-scroll {
      position: absolute; bottom: 2.5rem; left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 4;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem;
      color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      animation: scrollBounce 2.2s infinite;
    }
    @keyframes scrollBounce {
      0%,100% { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
      50%      { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(8px); }
    }

    /* ============================================================
       ICIP INFO BANNER
    ============================================================ */
    .icip-banner {
      padding: 1.75rem 2rem;
      border-radius: 16px;
      margin-top: 2.5rem;
      border-left: 4px solid var(--blue);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      align-items: center;
    }
    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .icip-banner { grid-template-columns: 1fr 280px; }
    }
    .icip-banner .icip-flag {
      font-size: 0.78rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--blue); margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .icip-banner h3 {
      font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
    }
    .icip-banner p {
      color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.8;
    }
    .icip-meta {
      display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.75rem; margin-top: 1.25rem;
    }
    .icip-photo-wrap {
      display: none;
      border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; height: 200px;
      position: relative;
    }
    @media (min-width: 768px) { .icip-photo-wrap { display: block; } }
    .icip-photo-wrap img {
      width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center;
      border-radius: 12px;
    }
    .icip-photo-wrap::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 12px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(10,15,30,0.25) 0%, transparent 60%);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       ABOUT
    ============================================================ */
    #about { background: var(--bg); }

    .about-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2rem;
    }
    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .about-grid { grid-template-columns: 1.25fr 1fr; align-items: start; }
    }

    .about-text p {
      color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 1.1rem;
      line-height: 1.85; margin-bottom: 1.35rem;
    }
    .about-text p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    .stat-cards {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 1rem; margin-top: 1.5rem;
    }
    .stat-card {
      padding: 1.35rem 1rem; text-align: center;
      border-radius: 12px; background: var(--bg-card2); border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .stat-card i { font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--cyan); margin-bottom: 0.55rem; display: block; }
    .stat-val { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; }
    .stat-lbl { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 0.15rem; }

    /* Imagery strip */
    .imagery-strip {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 0.85rem;
      margin-top: 1.75rem;
    }
    .imagery-item {
      position: relative; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3; cursor: default;
    }
    .imagery-item img {
      width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center;
      transition: transform 0.5s ease; display: block;
    }
    .imagery-item:hover img { transform: scale(1.07); }
    .imagery-item-overlay {
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(10,15,30,0.78) 0%, rgba(10,15,30,0.10) 55%, transparent 100%);
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .imagery-item-overlay {
      background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(10,15,30,0.65) 0%, rgba(10,15,30,0.05) 55%, transparent 100%);
    }
    .imagery-item-label {
      position: absolute; bottom: 0.55rem; left: 0; right: 0;
      text-align: center;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    }
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .imagery-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }

    /* Topic tags */
    .tags-block h4 {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.78rem;
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
    }
    .topic-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.65rem; }
    .tag {
      padding: 0.5rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 500;
      background: rgba(41,121,255,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(41,121,255,0.2);
      color: var(--text); cursor: default; transition: all 0.3s;
    }
    .tag:hover {
      background: rgba(0,229,255,0.1); border-color: rgba(0,229,255,0.4);
      color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0,229,255,0.18);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       SPEAKERS
    ============================================================ */
    #speakers { background: var(--bg-alt); }

    .speakers-tba {
      max-width: 680px; margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center; padding: 2.25rem 2rem;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background-image:
        repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 39px, rgba(41,121,255,0.05) 39px, rgba(41,121,255,0.05) 40px),
        repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, transparent 39px, rgba(41,121,255,0.05) 39px, rgba(41,121,255,0.05) 40px);
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .speakers-tba {
      background-image:
        repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 39px, rgba(21,101,192,0.06) 39px, rgba(21,101,192,0.06) 40px),
        repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, transparent 39px, rgba(21,101,192,0.06) 39px, rgba(21,101,192,0.06) 40px);
    }
    .speakers-tba-icon {
      width: 80px; height: 80px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(41,121,255,0.1); border: 2px solid rgba(41,121,255,0.25);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 1.25rem; font-size: 2rem; color: var(--blue);
    }
    .speakers-tba h3 { font-size: 1.55rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .speakers-tba p { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 1.08rem; line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
    .speakers-tba .badges { display: flex; gap: 0.65rem; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 1.5rem; }

    /* Speaker card (keynote) */
    .speaker-card {
      max-width: 820px; margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2rem;
      padding: 2.25rem 2rem; border-radius: 20px;
    }
    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .speaker-card { flex-direction: row; align-items: flex-start; }
    }
    .speaker-photo-wrap { position: relative; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .speaker-photo {
      width: 150px; height: 150px; border-radius: 50%;
      object-fit: cover; object-position: top center;
      border: 3px solid var(--border);
      transition: border-color 0.3s;
    }
    .speaker-card:hover .speaker-photo { border-color: var(--cyan); }
    .speaker-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.6rem; }
    .speaker-badges { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
    .speaker-talk-title {
      font-style: italic; color: var(--cyan); font-size: 1rem;
      line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
    }

    /* Modal */
    .modal-overlay {
      display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 2000;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.65); backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 1.5rem;
    }
    .modal-overlay.open { display: flex; }
    .modal-box {
      position: relative; max-width: 680px; width: 100%;
      max-height: 85vh; overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 2.25rem 2rem; border-radius: 18px;
    }
    .modal-close {
      position: absolute; top: 1rem; right: 1.25rem;
      background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 1.6rem; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .modal-close:hover { color: var(--text); }
    .modal-title {
      font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text);
      margin: 0.5rem 0 0.75rem; line-height: 1.45;
    }
    .modal-divider {
      border: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      margin: 1.25rem 0;
    }
    .modal-section-head {
      font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--cyan);
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      margin: 1.25rem 0 0.5rem;
    }
    .modal-box p {
      font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.75; margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       SCHEDULE
    ============================================================ */
    #schedule { background: var(--bg); }

    .schedule-note {
      text-align: center; margin-bottom: 2rem;
      color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .timeline { position: relative; max-width: 820px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .timeline::before {
      content: ''; position: absolute; left: 1.5rem; top: 0; bottom: 0;
      width: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--blue), var(--cyan), var(--teal));
      border-radius: 2px;
    }
    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .timeline::before { left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    .tl-item { position: relative; padding-left: 4rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .tl-item {
        padding-left: 0; display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 2.5rem 1fr; gap: 0 1.1rem; align-items: start;
      }
      .tl-item:nth-child(odd)  .tl-body { grid-column: 1; }
      .tl-item:nth-child(odd)  .tl-dot  { grid-column: 2; }
      .tl-item:nth-child(odd)  .tl-time { grid-column: 3; }
      .tl-item:nth-child(even) .tl-body { grid-column: 3; }
      .tl-item:nth-child(even) .tl-dot  { grid-column: 2; }
      .tl-item:nth-child(even) .tl-time { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; text-align: right; }
    }
    .tl-dot {
      position: absolute; left: 0.55rem; top: 0.3rem;
      width: 1rem; height: 1rem; border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid var(--bg); flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .tl-dot { position: static; justify-self: center; margin-top: 0.3rem; }
    }
    .tl-dot-keynote { background: var(--blue);       box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--blue); }
    .tl-dot-oral    { background: var(--cyan);        box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--cyan); }
    .tl-dot-poster  { background: var(--teal);        box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--teal); }
    .tl-dot-break   { background: var(--text-muted); }
    .tl-dot-award   { background: var(--gold);        box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--gold); }

    .tl-body { padding: 1.1rem 1.35rem; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .tl-type {
      font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
    }
    .tl-type-keynote { color: var(--blue);      }
    .tl-type-oral    { color: var(--cyan);      }
    .tl-type-poster  { color: var(--teal);      }
    .tl-type-break   { color: var(--text-muted);}
    .tl-type-award   { color: var(--gold);      }

    .tl-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; margin-bottom: 0.3rem; }
    .tl-desc  { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.65; }
    .tl-time  {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.82rem;
      color: var(--text-muted); padding-top: 1.3rem;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       CALL FOR PAPERS
    ============================================================ */
    #cfp { background: var(--bg-alt); }

    .cfp-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2.5rem; }
    @media (min-width: 1024px) { .cfp-grid { grid-template-columns: 1.25fr 1fr; } }

    .cfp-topics h3 { font-size: 1.2rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; color: var(--cyan); }

    .topic-group { margin-bottom: 1.35rem; }
    .topic-group h4 {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.78rem;
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      color: var(--blue); margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
    }
    .topic-list { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.6rem; }
    .topic-list li {
      display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.7rem;
      font-size: 0.98rem; color: var(--text-muted);
    }
    .topic-list li i { color: var(--cyan); font-size: 0.72rem; margin-top: 0.38rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

    /* Submission card */
    .sub-card { padding: 2.1rem; border-radius: 16px; }
    .sub-card h3 {
      font-size: 1.25rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem;
    }
    .sub-card h3 i { color: var(--blue); }

    .sub-row {
      display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.9rem;
      padding: 0.95rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .sub-row { border-bottom-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.06); }
    .sub-row:last-of-type { border-bottom: none; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }

    .sub-icon {
      width: 2.1rem; height: 2.1rem; border-radius: 8px;
      background: rgba(41,121,255,0.1); display: flex;
      align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0;
      color: var(--blue); font-size: 0.88rem;
    }

        <p class="section-label"><i class="fa-solid fa-microphone-lines"></i>  Keynote Address</p>
        <h3 class="modal-title">"From Fields to Fires to Fens: Integrating Deep Learning and Multi-Sensor Earth Observation for Global Environmental Resilience"</h3>
        <p class="org-role" style="margin-bottom:0;">Prof. Kevin Tansey · University of Leicester, UK</p>
        <hr class="modal-divider" />
        <h4 class="modal-section-head">Abstract</h4>
        <p>The convergence of climate change and population growth necessitates advanced Earth Observation (EO) frameworks to monitor terrestrial ecosystems and ensure food security. This talk explores the evolution of remote sensing methodologies — transitioning from traditional statistical models to sophisticated deep learning architectures — to address three critical environmental pillars: agricultural productivity, wildfire dynamics, and peatland preservation.</p>
        <p>In the agricultural domain, the research takes two pathways. The first is a multi-scale deep learning framework integrating time-series satellite data, meteorological variables, and soil characteristics. Using models such as LSTM and neural networks, high-precision county-level yield estimates of crops such as winter wheat are achieved. The second pathway, developed with industry partners in the UK and Nigeria, predicts crop status, harvest windows, and crop type for the determination of crop waste availability for biofuel through a pyrolysis process.</p>
        <p>The increasing frequency of extreme weather events has triggered an increase in wildfire activity outside of normal fire seasons. Work on automated processing pipelines using high-resolution PlanetScope and Sentinel imagery to characterise burned area will be discussed. Using adaptive machine learning classifications, 3-metre resolution burned-area maps are generated, enabling rapid response and long-term ecological impact assessment.</p>
        <p>An overview of findings from the ESA WorldPeatland project — an international initiative dedicated to EO-based mapping and monitoring of peatland hydrology — will be presented. Peatlands are vital carbon sinks, yet highly vulnerable to drainage and fire. The catalogue of products created by the project team and insights into peatland extent, hydrology, and surface motion will be discussed.</p>
        <p>Finally, Prof. Tansey will outline the changing direction of remote sensing and Earth observation research as seen through his role as Editor-in-Chief of the <em>International Journal of Remote Sensing</em>, and the challenges faced by the community regarding the use and misuse of AI in scientific publishing.</p>
        <h4 class="modal-section-head">About the Speaker</h4>
        <p>Kevin Tansey is a Geographer who has worked as a remote sensing scientist since 1995. He has published 112 papers in international peer-reviewed journals across application fields including agriculture, wildfire and hazards assessment, forestry, and renewable energies. He works with all forms of EO data — optical, thermal, radar, and LiDAR — from the ground to space.</p>
        <p>He is Editor-in-Chief of the <em>International Journal of Remote Sensing</em>. He has previously held positions on the United Nations World Meteorological Organization (WMO) Terrestrial Observations Panel for Climate (TOPC) and has been co-chair of the Committee of Earth Observing Satellites (CEOS) Land Product Validation sub-group on fire disturbance. He has supervised more than 25 PhD students and has over 20 years of teaching experience in remote sensing, GIS, and statistics for data science.</p>

<script>
  // ============================================================
  // 1. THEME TOGGLE
  // ============================================================
  function initTheme() {
    const btn  = document.getElementById('themeBtn');
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('hydroimaging-theme') || 'dark';
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', saved);
    updateIcon(saved);

    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const cur  = root.getAttribute('data-theme');
      const next = cur === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
      root.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
      localStorage.setItem('hydroimaging-theme', next);
      updateIcon(next);
    });

    function updateIcon(theme) {
      btn.innerHTML = theme === 'dark'
        ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-sun"></i>'
        : '<i class="fa-solid fa-moon"></i>';
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // 2. CANVAS PARTICLES
  // ============================================================
  function initParticles() {
    const canvas = document.getElementById('hero-canvas');
    const ctx    = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const NUM    = 80;
    const DIST   = 150;
    let W, H, particles = [];

    function isDark() {
      return document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') !== 'light';
    }

    function resize() {
      W = canvas.width  = window.innerWidth;
      H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    }

    class Particle {
      constructor() { this.reset(); }
      reset() {
        this.x  = Math.random() * W;
        this.y  = Math.random() * H;
        this.vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4;
        this.vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4;
        this.r  = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
        this.a  = Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2;
      }
      update() {
        this.x += this.vx;
        this.y += this.vy;
        if (this.x < 0 || this.x > W) this.vx *= -1;
        if (this.y < 0 || this.y > H) this.vy *= -1;
      }
      draw() {
        const dark = isDark();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = dark
          ? `rgba(41,121,255,${this.a})`
          : `rgba(21,101,192,${this.a * 0.7})`;
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }

    function init() {
      resize();
      particles = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < NUM; i++) particles.push(new Particle());
    }

    function animate() {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
      const dark = isDark();

      for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
        for (let j = i + 1; j < particles.length; j++) {
          const dx   = particles[i].x - particles[j].x;
          const dy   = particles[i].y - particles[j].y;
          const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
          if (dist < DIST) {
            const op = (1 - dist / DIST) * (dark ? 0.22 : 0.15);
            const g  = ctx.createLinearGradient(particles[i].x, particles[i].y, particles[j].x, particles[j].y);
            if (dark) {
              g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(41,121,255,${op})`);
              g.addColorStop(1, `rgba(0,229,255,${op})`);
            } else {
              g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(21,101,192,${op})`);
              g.addColorStop(1, `rgba(0,119,182,${op})`);
            }
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(particles[i].x, particles[i].y);
            ctx.lineTo(particles[j].x, particles[j].y);
            ctx.strokeStyle = g;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        }
      }
      particles.forEach(p => { p.update(); p.draw(); });
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    window.addEventListener('resize', init, { passive: true });
    init();
    animate();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // 3. SCROLL ANIMATIONS
  // ============================================================
  function initScrollAnim() {
    const obs = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      entries.forEach(e => {
        if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('visible'); obs.unobserve(e.target); }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.1 });
    document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in').forEach(el => obs.observe(el));
  }

  // ============================================================
  // 4. NAVBAR
  // ============================================================
  function initNavbar() {
    const nav = document.getElementById('navbar');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 60);
    }, { passive: true });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // 5. COUNTDOWN
  // ============================================================
  function initCountdown(target) {
    function pad(n) { return String(n).padStart(2, '0'); }
    function tick() {
      const diff = target - Date.now();
      if (diff <= 0) {
        ['cd-days','cd-hours','cd-mins','cd-secs','mcd-d','mcd-h','mcd-m'].forEach(id => {
          const el = document.getElementById(id);
          if (el) el.textContent = '00';
        });
        return;
      }
      const d = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);
      const h = Math.floor((diff % 86400000) / 3600000);
      const m = Math.floor((diff % 3600000) / 60000);
      const s = Math.floor((diff % 60000) / 1000);
      [['cd-days',d],['cd-hours',h],['cd-mins',m],['cd-secs',s],
       ['mcd-d',d],['mcd-h',h],['mcd-m',m]].forEach(([id,v]) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.textContent = pad(v);
      });
    }
    tick();
    setInterval(tick, 1000);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // 6. MOBILE MENU
  // ============================================================
  function initMobileMenu() {
    const btn  = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    const menu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      btn.classList.toggle('open');
      menu.classList.toggle('open');
    });
    menu.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => a.addEventListener('click', () => {
      btn.classList.remove('open');
      menu.classList.remove('open');
    }));
  }

  // ============================================================
  // BOOT
  // ============================================================
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    initTheme();
    initParticles();
    initScrollAnim();
    initNavbar();
    // May 13, 2026 23:59 AoE = May 14, 2026 11:59 UTC
    initCountdown(new Date('2026-05-14T11:59:00Z').getTime());
    initMobileMenu();
    initSlideshow();
  });

  // ============================================================
  // 7. SPEAKER MODALS
  // ============================================================
  function openSpeakerModal(id) {
    const modal = document.getElementById('modal-' + id);
    if (modal) { modal.classList.add('open'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; }
  }
  function closeSpeakerModal(e, id) {
    if (e && e.target && e.target.id !== 'modal-' + id) return;
    const modal = document.getElementById('modal-' + id);
    if (modal) { modal.classList.remove('open'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; }
  }
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      document.querySelectorAll('.modal-overlay.open').forEach(m => {
        m.classList.remove('open');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      });
    }
  });

  function initSlideshow() {
    const imgs = [
      't1.jpg','t2.jpg','t3.jpg','t4.jpg','t5.jpg','t6.jpg','t7.jpg',
      't8.jpg','t10.jpg','t11.jpg','t12.jpg','t13.jpg','t14.jpg','t15.jpg'
    ];
    const wrap = document.getElementById('heroSlideshow');
    imgs.forEach((name, i) => {
      const el = document.createElement('div');
      el.className = 'hero-slide' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
      el.style.backgroundImage = "url('assets/tampere/" + name + "')";
      wrap.appendChild(el);
    });
    let cur = 0;
    setInterval(() => {
      const slides = wrap.children;
      slides[cur].classList.remove('active');
      cur = (cur + 1) % slides.length;
      slides[cur].classList.add('active');
    }, 4000);
  }
</script>
</body>
</html>
